# Avanti Jewels

Avanti Jewels is an Indian jewelry boutique serving Hicksville, New York. The full catalog includes necklaces, complete jewelry sets, bangles, bracelets, earrings, rings, pendants, mang tikka and kamarband. Products are browsed online and purchases, local pickup or local delivery are confirmed directly with Avanti Jewels.

Available items may be reserved by phone for 24 hours with customer contact information. Payment is accepted by cash or Venmo. All sales are final, with no returns or exchanges. Avanti Jewels does not offer shipping, alterations, deposits, installment plans or custom orders.
